notes.title: Version 1.7 has been released!
notes.content:
Dear adventurer:

Hello! We are pleased to inform you that:

Version 1.7 has been released!

This is the patch that includes:

(1) Fixed resolution bug
(2) Added mercenary tutorial
(3) Added gem tutorial
(4) Optimized skill values
(5) Optimized combat values

The game will constantly add new characters, NPCs, items, and gems! If you have any comments on the game, have found bugs and translation errors, please send an email to: YoungMage@qq.com We will reply to you within 48 hours!

Good luck! have fun！
